latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-emas-apm-query — a troubleshooting skill for Alibaba Cloud EMAS APM (Application Performance Monitoring):

- Supports root cause analysis for 6 issue types: crash, anr, lag, custom, memory_leak, memory_alloc
- Integrates the 4 read-only OpenAPIs: get-issues, get-issue, get-errors, get-error
- Covers native Android/iOS/HarmonyOS, Flutter, and Unity apps
- Provides stack trace mapping against user source code for actionable fix suggestions
- Enforces RAM permission checks and parameter confirmation for secure, user-guided operations
